profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
8 years experience working with LG webOS and all related technologies, see below.

Mobile development - Games:
    Dungeon Defenders
    Warm Gun
    Various prototypes

Mobile development - Other:
    GVoice / SynerGV (webOS, PlayBook, Android)
    XO: Subsonic Commander (webOS, PlayBook)

Console development - Games:
   Dungeon Defenders (Unreal Engine 3)

PC development - Games:
    Ground Branch Online (Unreal Engine 3)
    Rikochet (Unreal Engine 3)
    Dungeon Defenders (Unreal Engine 3)
    Duke Nukem Reloaded (Unreal Engine - UDK)
    Gunreal 2004 (Unreal Engine - UT2004)
    Dead Awake (Unreal Engine - UT2003)
    Various prototypes

PC development - Other:
    Point-of-sale retail system for dog grooming shop (PHP)
    Free Poker Database (Python)

See also http://github.com/ericblade
   
I have been programming as a hobby for over 30 years, and professionally for over 10, mostly all with Unreal Engine and UnrealScript for games, and Javascript, PHP, and HTML for other realms, with a bit of C++,  C# and Python thrown in.

I have over 7 years experience with various versions of the Unreal Engine, from Unreal Engine 2 through to Unreal Engine 4 (mostly in Unreal Engine 3).

I also have over 10 years experience in sales and retail unit management.  

I seek to use and expand my knowledge of programming, video game development, and design to help design and create new interactive experiences for everyone - casual and serious alike.  

Outside of gaming, I'd like to work on something that will change the world for some person(s).  I know even the most mundane seeming thing to those of us in technology can change someone's world -- it's happened to me, and I'd like to make that happen for others.

Specialties: JavaScript (node and browser), webOS, PHP, UnrealScript, Unreal Engine, UnrealEd, Python, Software testing and bug fixing, optimizing flow of interpreted language code, dealing poker, employee management, sales, retail management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Helped development team to prepare release of TWD Saints & Sinners Aftershocks release, assisting with a merge and repair of several divergent platform source trees.
- Presently developing new gameplay features, with a concentration on AI matters and implementation.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Virtual Reality (VR) · Game Programming · Game Development · Gameplay · Unreal Engine 4

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted to LG Electronics to work on significant software updates for the webOS based LG Interactive Digital Board v2.0. https://www.lg.com/global/business/information-display/digital-signage/lg-86TN3F-B

Designed and wrote network file sharing APIs, contributed to on-device networking and user-interface concerns.

Later worked in R&D department on projects using Unity3D 2018, Unreal Engine 4.22, QT 5.13, AR and VR technologies for real-world simulations.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Virtual Reality (VR) · Augmented Reality (AR) · Unreal Engine 4

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- 1/17-12/17 - Advanced/Automotive Platforms
- Designed and implemented components for automotive simulation, connecting Unity3D engine to a myriad network of hardware and software components, including but not limited to dashboard and IVI components, cloud services, Amazon Voice Service (AVS/Alexa). (NodeJS, QML, C#)
- Implementation of steering wheel enhancements (C++, C#)
- Assist with implementation of AVS software for embedded hardware (Qt,C++,QML)
- Design and implement cloud services to support AVS / Alexa Skills to develop prototypes (NodeJS)
- Contribution to several open source packages at github
- Implement AWS cloud system for data collection and analysis

- 1/15-1/17 - LG SVL Apps and Services team
- Contributed to system applications in LG webOS 2.0-3.5 (QML, HTML5, JavaScript, Enyo, Enact/React)
- Involved in benchmarking and improving performance of apps and services on LG Watch Urbane LTE (QML, HTML5, JavaScript, Enyo)
- Refactored webOS notification system that had been built into system UI, into a separately loadable code module, used in webOS 3.0+ (QML)
- Involved in development of system applications using Javascript ES6 technologies and frameworks, including React, Redux, Webpack, Browserify, Babelify, Enact, and others
- Contributor to webOS Qt 5 QML user interface, compositor, and NodeJS support services and frameworks in LG webOS 1.0-3.5
- Initial engineering implementation of Interactive Digital Board product

- 10/13 to 1/17 - Apps, services, and system work
- Designed and implemented new features for LG webOS UI/UX specifications, webOS service infrastructures, and UI  (C++, QML)
- Lead engineer for LG webOS 1.x/2.x WebAppManager 2 project from 10/13 to 12/14, coordinating design, implementation, and take up of new requirements and changes to WebAppManager (C++, Qt 5)
- Developed much of "My Channels" system UI functionality for webOS 2.x and support code for same in 3.x, significant contributions to other NodeJS and QML features

positions.title: webOS Engineer (contract)
positions.description:
As LG purchased the webOS resources from HP, this is a continuation of my previous work with HP.

Assisted with porting several webOS components from Open webOS to the LG Smart TV hardware platform, upgrading components to use Qt 5 from Qt 4.8, and upgrading the Qt platform installation in the OpenEmbedded build system.

Became lead engineer for the WebAppManager 2.0 component used in LG webOS 1.0, which runs all HTML/Javascript/web-technology based applications inside webOS.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer (contract)
positions.description: Working on significant upgrades to the components that make up Open webOS, as well as working with the OpenEmbedded build system, and enhancing the portability of Open webOS in general.

positions.title: Poker Dealer / Tournament Director
positions.description: Charitable casino - directing poker tournaments, dealing cards during poker games

company.name: The Poker Room at The Heidelberg

positions.title: Customer Service Rep
positions.description: Answered incoming calls for a variety of telephone based sales and customer service clients, such as warranty repair handling, recall item handling, television shopping, and more

positions.title: Unreal Engine Programmer/Technology Lead (contract)
positions.description:
Engine level and gameplay programming and design in Unreal Engine 3 for a mobile iOS/Android prototype project backed by a major publisher.

Advised all departments on best practices for working with Unreal Engine in a mobile environment and designed and implemented several gameplay systems in UnrealScript as well as supporting engine-level C++ code.

Additionally responsible for Unreal Engine project setup and configuration, integration of updates and patches to the Engine from the master code at Epic.

positions.title: Unreal Engine Programmer (contract)
positions.description: Helped to perform several very specific optimizations to various UnrealScript and Unreal Engine codes and advised artists on optimization techniques, for the iPhone/iPod/iPad version of Warm Gun

positions.title: Gameplay Programmer
positions.description:
UnrealScript gameplay and AI programming for iOS/Android/X360/PS3/PC title Dungeon Defenders

Programmed the AI for several enemy characters, as well as the player abilities for the Monk character class, and general improvements and gameplay enhancements and bug fixes throughout the game.

positions.description: Complete retail store operations, sales, and oversight for individual retail locations of up to $1M in yearly sales.

positions.description: Bag groceries, clean store, pretty much any misc task no one else was tasked with
